pokdeng.setupIntro: Set up the table: one host against the players. Each turn adds or subtracts credit.
pokdeng.baseBetHint: Credit moved by a normal x1 win.
pokdeng.baseBetChangeHint: Applies from the next turn — settled turns keep their own bet.
pokdeng.hostHint: The host mirrors the table — everything the players win comes out of the host's credit.
pokdeng.noPlayers: No players left at the table. Add someone to keep playing.
pokdeng.historyEmpty: No turns settled yet. Pick win or lose for a player, then settle the turn.
pokdeng.managePlayersHint: Rename, add or remove players. Removing one takes their balance off the table.
pokdeng.resetBody: Reset credits keeps the same players and clears every balance and turn. New game clears everything and returns to setup.

lobby.title: Mic Link
lobby.description: Use one or more phones as wireless microphones for this device. The audio streams straight to it over your local network.
lobby.step1: Start a session on the device that should receive the audio.
lobby.step2: Scan the QR code with each phone and allow microphone access.
lobby.step3: Balance the mics, listen on headphones, or record the mix to a file.
lobby.privacy: The audio goes peer-to-peer and is never uploaded — only the connection handshake passes through the server.

sender.title: This phone is the microphone
sender.wakeLockOn: The screen is kept awake while connected — locking it would cut the audio.
sender.wakeLockOff: Keep this screen on. Locking the phone will cut the audio.
sender.selfMonitorHint: Plays your mic straight back on this phone, skipping the network. Wired headphones only — speakers will howl, and Bluetooth adds more delay than it saves.

receiver.title: This device receives the audio
receiver.scanPrompt: Scan this with each phone you want to use as a microphone.
receiver.qrAlt: QR code that opens Mic Link on your phone
receiver.sameNetworkHint: Both devices should be on the same wifi. If they are not, the audio still works but takes a longer route.
receiver.monitorHint: Use headphones — speakers will feed back into the phones' microphones.
receiver.roomFull: All microphone slots are in use
receiver.noInputs: No microphones yet. Scan the QR code with a phone to add one.
receiver.lowLatencyHint: Shrinks the receive buffer. Much less delay for singing, but more sensitive to a busy network.
receiver.latencyCaveat: Excludes the phone's own capture buffer, usually another 10–20ms.
